name: io.github.milisp.mcp-linker/keenable
title: Keenable
description: Live web search and clean-markdown page fetch for AI agents. Keyless, no sign-in.

io.github.milisp.mcp-linker.fullDescription: Keenable's hosted MCP server. Two read-only tools: search_web_pages (a query, with optional site, published_after/published_before and max_results filters) and fetch_page_content (returns a URL as clean markdown, with an optional extraction prompt). Search queries and requested URLs are sent to Keenable. Works without a key or sign-in, capped per hour per IP; an optional X-API-Key header with a Keenable key removes the cap.
